title: Code Innovate Hackathon
description: A 24-hour hackathon where students build solutions for real-world problems, mentored by industry experts.
fullWriteUp: Code Innovate is JYC's flagship 24-hour hackathon. Teams of 2-4 students tackle challenges across AI, fintech, health, and sustainability. Expect surprise problem statements, curated mentors, and an overnight theatre-style build sprint culminating in demos in front of a panel of judges.

title: Ignite Cultural Fest
description: An evening of music, dance, and drama celebrating the diverse cultures of JIIT.
fullWriteUp: Ignite is JYC's annual cultural fest. From classical recitals to contemporary choreography and street plays, the evening showcases JIIT's brightest talent. The fest closes with a headline performance by student musicians and a DJ night under the stars.

title: Youth Leadership Summit
description: A day-long summit with inspiring talks and workshops on leadership, entrepreneurship, and civic responsibility.
fullWriteUp: The Youth Leadership Summit brings entrepreneurs, civic leaders, and change-makers to JIIT for a full day of talks, panel discussions, and hands-on workshops. Students leave with leadership frameworks, practical communication skills, and a network of like-minded peers.

title: Tech Talk: AI in the Real World
description: Industry practitioners unpack how AI is deployed in production across fintech and healthcare.
fullWriteUp: A fireside-style session where engineers from local startups and product teams show how AI actually ships: data pipelines, evaluation, and cost trade-offs. Bring questions and your laptop — a live mini-workshop follows the talk.

title: JYC Induction 2026
description: Kick-off ceremony welcoming new members, with hub introductions and club roadmap for the year.
fullWriteUp: The academic year begins with Induction — a lively ceremony where the leadership team presents the club's vision, each hub stages a short showcase, and new members formally join their chosen team.

title: Sportstice Inter-College Meet
description: A weekend of competitive sports — football, cricket, badminton, and athletics — against 12 visiting colleges.
fullWriteUp: Sportstice put JIIT's sporting culture on the map. Teams from across the NCR competed across four disciplines over two action-packed days, with the home crowd cheering the football and cricket finals to the finish.

title: Design Week 2026
description: A week of UI/UX workshops, design critiques, and a poster-design competition open to all students.
fullWriteUp: Design Week explored everything from typography to prototyping. Students workshopped real briefs, received portfolio feedback from working designers, and closed the week with a poster competition whose entries still decorate the design studio.

title: Campus Clean Drive
description: A volunteer-led cleanup and tree-plantation drive across the JIIT campus and nearby community.
fullWriteUp: In partnership with NSS JIIT, the clean drive gathered 150 volunteers who cleaned a two-kilometre stretch around the campus and planted 300 native saplings. A small step toward the club's larger sustainability pledge.

title: Media Lab: Photography & Storytelling
description: An introductory workshop on phone photography, framing, and short-form video storytelling.
fullWriteUp: The Media Lab workshop turned phones into cameras. Students learned composition rules, lighting hacks, and a fast editing workflow, then put it into practice on a sunset photo walk around campus.
